How to read this dashboard

This is a browser-based version of the workbook dashboard using its 2015 sales snapshot. It does not maintain a live connection to your open Excel file.

Revenue is calculated from the matching order-line quantity multiplied by its fixed pizza price. Orders count distinct baskets containing at least one matching line; active customers count distinct anonymous customers within those baskets. Revenue per order uses matching revenue divided by matching orders.

Revenue bands apply to each order line: Low is below $20; Moderate is $20–$60 inclusive; High is above $60. An order may contain lines from more than one category or band, so adding filtered order counts can double-count orders.

Customer labels are anonymised. Spending describes the selected historical period, rather than predicted customer lifetime value. Revenue does not represent profit. Recommendations identify questions to investigate; they do not establish causes or proven business results.
